_comment: Phase 0 draft — USGS Earthquake GeoJSON feed configuration

_availableVariants.all_hour: All earthquakes, past hour (typically 10-30 events, ~15 KB)
_availableVariants.all_day: All earthquakes, past day (typically 200-400 events, ~300 KB)
_availableVariants.all_week: All earthquakes, past week (typically 1500-3000 events, ~2 MB)
_availableVariants.all_month: All earthquakes, past month (typically 8000-12000 events, ~10 MB)
_availableVariants.significant_month: Significant earthquakes only, past month (typically 5-20 events)

_selectedRationale: all_day provides a good balance: enough events to demonstrate real-time earthquake monitoring without overwhelming the CSAPI server. Updated by USGS every minute. Roughly 200-400 features per fetch.

dedupeStrategy.description: Each earthquake has a stable event ID. The 'updated' timestamp changes when USGS revises magnitude, location, or status. Publisher should track (id, updated) tuples to avoid re-publishing unchanged events while catching revisions.
